content:
Baawo ko laawol wagon ngol wonnoo tan lekki ɗiɗi yaajooɗi e ngiyam, ɗum yetti puccu ɗi ngaddata wagon ɗon ngooduya ɗuɗɗa e ndarnaaɗi ɗuɗɗa ɗoo tawaa e laawɒle nde wakkati ɗon, ɗe ngonnoo ɗuuɗɗe ɗiwal.

Correction (final version):

Hay so laawɗe wagon ɗe wonnoo tan leggal ɗiɗi yaajooji ngalaa goɗɗum, ɗe ngartiri puccu ɗi ngaddata wagon ɗon, ngaɗa yaawugol ɓurngol e ndawa ɓurɗum ɗuuɗugol, ɓurɗum laawɗe nder jamanu ɗu, ɗe ngonnoo hesɗitinɗe seɗɗa.
